title: File Transfer Protocol

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 959 defines distinct FTP control and data connections and Protocol Interpreter/Data Transfer Process roles.
RFC 959 explicitly states that FTP uses Telnet protocol conventions on the control connection.
claims_extracted.locator: Relationship between FTP and Telnet; command syntax discussion

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 959 obsoletes RFC 765/IEN 149 and preserves a historical summary reaching back to RFC 114.

notes: Central primary source for mature FTP architecture and its long RFC genealogy.
